title: What customers see when processing fails or is partial
question: Which processing states does a customer see (in progress, partly processed, failed), with what wording, and is the customer told by email? Are error tags such as "Improper lighting" shown to customers, and must a failed capture always come with a recommended action?
context: Jobs carry a processing status and error tags (PROC-REQ-008). TechOps can set the outcome by hand (PROC-REQ-016), and a PRD asks for categorised issue emails with help articles (PROC-REQ-025). How much of this reaches the customer is not defined. LIVE itself is DEC-025.
